checkpoints.title: Arrive in Vienna
checkpoints.description: Today is cold and rainy — wear a warm layer and pack the umbrella in the daypack. Grab a public transport day ticket as soon as you land.

checkpoints.title: Head to the visa appointment
checkpoints.description: Go straight to the appointment location before doing anything else — leave luggage buffer time. Confirm the exact address the night before.

checkpoints.title: Visa appointment
checkpoints.description: Arrive ~10 minutes early. Bring every document, the printed confirmation, passport, and copies. Once this is done, the rest of the day is free.

checkpoints.title: Lunch — Figlmüller
checkpoints.description: Celebrate the appointment being over with the legendary oversized Wiener Schnitzel. Cosy and indoors, perfect for the rain. Booking a table helps.

checkpoints.title: Kunsthistorisches Museum
checkpoints.description: The perfect rainy-afternoon shelter — one of the world's great art museums (Bruegel, Vermeer, Caravaggio) in a stunning palace building. Easy to lose a few hours here.

checkpoints.title: Viennese coffee house
checkpoints.description: Warm up the classic way: a Melange and a slice of Sachertorte or Apfelstrudel in a grand café like Café Central or Café Sacher.

checkpoints.title: Check in at Nest Natur Hostel
checkpoints.description: Head out to the 14th district (Penzing) and settle in. Josef-Palme-Platz 4, 1140 Wien. Dry off and rest.

checkpoints.title: Dinner near the hostel
checkpoints.description: Easy dinner along Mariahilfer Straße or near the hostel — plenty of options a few U-Bahn stops away. Early night since tomorrow is the big day out.

checkpoints.title: Breakfast & check out
checkpoints.description: Pack up and check out. Leave the luggage at hostel reception so the day stays hands-free — you'll grab it before leaving.

checkpoints.title: Schönbrunn Palace & Gardens
checkpoints.description: It's sunny today, so head to Schönbrunn first — it's just one district over from the hostel. Wander the free gardens, walk up to the Gloriette for the city view, and tour the palace interior.

checkpoints.title: Lunch in the city centre
checkpoints.description: Take the U4 into the centre. Grab lunch around Stephansplatz or the Naschmarkt area.

checkpoints.title: Old Town stroll
checkpoints.description: Enjoy the sunshine on foot — Stephansdom, the Graben, Kärntner Straße, and the Hofburg. Soak up the centre at an easy pace.

checkpoints.title: Collect luggage from hostel
checkpoints.description: Head back to Penzing to pick up the bags. Don't cut this close — build in buffer for the 17:36 departure.

checkpoints.title: Travel to departure point
checkpoints.description: Make your way to the airport / station with margin to spare. Check passport, tickets, and phone before you go.
